reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getBudgetableCategories and setAllNMonthAvg helpers and a shared MonthWideArgs type; copyPreviousMonth, which already had its own exclusion checks, is extended in place rather than routed through the helper.

duplication.why: The hidden-exclusion-unless-flag rule is now written twice (SQL fragment in getBudgetableCategories and a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth), and the test adds runAllHidden as a near copy of the existing runAll helper.

placement.why: The option lives on the shared selection helper and the month-wide action signatures in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the flag, signature changes for the month-wide actions, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single optional flag on the shared selection is clear, but the pre-existing split with copyPreviousMonth means the flag's meaning must be kept in sync in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth keeps applying hidden/group-hidden (now with the flag), template and #fixed exclusions inline instead of using getBudgetableCategories.
